title: Do text embeddings perfectly encode text?
title_zh: 作为文本嵌入能否完美编码文本的探讨：vector database 的兴起

paragraphs.en: As a result of the rapid advancement of generative AI in recent years, many companies are rushing to integrate AI into their businesses. One of the most common ways of doing this is to build AI systems that answer questions concerning information that can be found within a database of documents. Most solutions for such a problem are based on one key technique: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) .
paragraphs.zh: 近年来，生成式人工智能的快速发展促使许多公司竞相将 AI 融入其业务中。 其中最常见的做法之一是构建 AI 系统，用于回答与文档数据库中可查到的信息相关的问题。 针对此类问题的大多数解决方案都基于一项关键技术：检索增强生成（RAG）。

sents.en: As a result of the rapid advancement of generative AI in recent years, many companies are rushing to integrate AI into their businesses.
sents.zh: 近年来，生成式人工智能的快速发展促使许多公司竞相将 AI 融入其业务中。

sents.en: One of the most common ways of doing this is to build AI systems that answer questions concerning information that can be found within a database of documents.
sents.zh: 其中最常见的做法之一是构建 AI 系统，用于回答与文档数据库中可查到的信息相关的问题。

sents.en: Most solutions for such a problem are based on one key technique: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) .
sents.zh: 针对此类问题的大多数解决方案都基于一项关键技术：检索增强生成（RAG）。

paragraphs.en: This is what lots of people do now as a cheap and easy way to get started using AI: store lots of documents in a database, have the AI retrieve the most relevant documents for a given input, and then generate a response to the input that is informed by the retrieved documents.
paragraphs.zh: 这就是现在很多人采用的廉价而简单的 AI 入门方法：将大量文档存储在数据库中，让 AI 针对给定输入检索出最相关的文档，然后结合检索到的文档生成对该输入的回复。

paragraphs.en: These RAG systems determine document relevancy by using “embeddings”, vector representations of documents produced by an embedding model. These embeddings are supposed to represent some notion of similarity, so documents that are relevant for search will have high vector similarity in embedding space.
paragraphs.zh: 这些 RAG 系统通过「嵌入」（embedding）来判断文档的相关性，嵌入是由嵌入模型生成的文档向量表示。 这些嵌入应当表达某种相似性概念，因此与搜索相关的文档在嵌入空间中会具有较高的向量相似度。

sents.en: These RAG systems determine document relevancy by using “embeddings”, vector representations of documents produced by an embedding model.
sents.zh: 这些 RAG 系统通过「嵌入」（embedding）来判断文档的相关性，嵌入是由嵌入模型生成的文档向量表示。

sents.en: These embeddings are supposed to represent some notion of similarity, so documents that are relevant for search will have high vector similarity in embedding space.
sents.zh: 这些嵌入应当表达某种相似性概念，因此与搜索相关的文档在嵌入空间中会具有较高的向量相似度。

paragraphs.en: The prevalence of RAG has led to the rise of the vector database , a new type of database designed for storing and searching through large numbers of embeddings. Hundreds of millions of dollars of funding have been given out to startups that claim to facilitate RAG by making embedding search easy. And the effectiveness of RAG is the reason why lots of new applications are converting text to vectors and storing them in these vector databases.
paragraphs.zh: RAG 的流行催生了向量数据库的兴起，这是一种新型数据库，专为存储和检索大量嵌入向量而设计。 数亿美元的资金已投给了那些声称通过让嵌入向量检索变得简单来促进 RAG 的初创公司。 RAG 的有效性正是许多新应用将文本转换为向量并存入这些向量数据库的原因。

sents.en: The prevalence of RAG has led to the rise of the vector database , a new type of database designed for storing and searching through large numbers of embeddings.
sents.zh: RAG 的流行催生了向量数据库的兴起，这是一种新型数据库，专为存储和检索大量嵌入向量而设计。

sents.en: Hundreds of millions of dollars of funding have been given out to startups that claim to facilitate RAG by making embedding search easy.
sents.zh: 数亿美元的资金已投给了那些声称通过让嵌入向量检索变得简单来促进 RAG 的初创公司。

sents.en: And the effectiveness of RAG is the reason why lots of new applications are converting text to vectors and storing them in these vector databases.
sents.zh: RAG 的有效性正是许多新应用将文本转换为向量并存入这些向量数据库的原因。

paragraphs.en: So what is stored in a text embedding? Beyond the requirement of semantic similarity, there are no constraints on which embedding must be assigned for a given text input. Numbers within embedding vectors can be anything , and vary based on their initialization. We can interpret the similarities of embedding with others but have no hope ever understanding the individual numbers of an embedding.
paragraphs.zh: 那么文本嵌入中存储的到底是什么？ 除了语义相似性的要求之外，对于给定的文本输入，必须分配哪个嵌入并没有任何约束。 嵌入向量中的数字可以是任何值，并且会因其初始化方式而有所不同。 我们可以解释嵌入与其他嵌入之间的相似性，但永远无法理解嵌入中单个数字的含义。

sents.en: So what is stored in a text embedding?
sents.zh: 那么文本嵌入中存储的到底是什么？

sents.en: Beyond the requirement of semantic similarity, there are no constraints on which embedding must be assigned for a given text input.
sents.zh: 除了语义相似性的要求之外，对于给定的文本输入，必须分配哪个嵌入并没有任何约束。

sents.en: Numbers within embedding vectors can be anything , and vary based on their initialization.
sents.zh: 嵌入向量中的数字可以是任何值，并且会因其初始化方式而有所不同。

sents.en: We can interpret the similarities of embedding with others but have no hope ever understanding the individual numbers of an embedding.
sents.zh: 我们可以解释嵌入与其他嵌入之间的相似性，但永远无法理解嵌入中单个数字的含义。

paragraphs.en: Now imagine you’re a software engineer building a RAG system for your company. You decide to store your vectors in a vector database. You notice that in a vector database, what's stored are embedding vectors, not the text data itself. The database fills up with rows and rows of random-seeming numbers that represent text data but never ‘sees’ any text data at all. You know that the text corresponds to customer documents that are protected by your company’s privacy policy. But you’re not really sending text off-premises at any time; you only ever send embedding vectors, which look to you like random numbers. What if someone hacks into the database and gains access to all your text embedding vectors – would this be bad? Or if the service provider wanted to sell your data to advertisers – could they? Both scenarios involve being able to take embedding vectors and invert them somehow back to text.
paragraphs.zh: 现在想象你是一名软件工程师，正在为公司构建一个 RAG 系统。 你决定把向量存储在向量数据库中。 你注意到，在向量数据库中，存储的是嵌入向量，而不是文本数据本身。 数据库中填满了一行行看似随机的数字，这些数字代表文本数据，但数据库从未「看到」任何文本数据。 你知道这些文本对应的是受公司隐私政策保护的客户文档。 但实际上你从未在任何时候把文本发送到公司之外；你发送的只是嵌入向量，而在你看来它们就像随机数字。 如果有人入侵数据库并获取了你所有的文本嵌入向量——这会很糟糕吗？ 或者如果服务提供商想把你的数据卖给广告商——他们能做到吗？ 这两种场景都涉及能够以某种方式将嵌入向量逆向还原回文本。

sents.en: Now imagine you’re a software engineer building a RAG system for your company.
sents.zh: 现在想象你是一名软件工程师，正在为公司构建一个 RAG 系统。

sents.en: You decide to store your vectors in a vector database.
sents.zh: 你决定把向量存储在向量数据库中。

sents.en: You notice that in a vector database, what's stored are embedding vectors, not the text data itself.
sents.zh: 你注意到，在向量数据库中，存储的是嵌入向量，而不是文本数据本身。

sents.en: The database fills up with rows and rows of random-seeming numbers that represent text data but never ‘sees’ any text data at all.
sents.zh: 数据库中填满了一行行看似随机的数字，这些数字代表文本数据，但数据库从未「看到」任何文本数据。

sents.en: You know that the text corresponds to customer documents that are protected by your company’s privacy policy.
sents.zh: 你知道这些文本对应的是受公司隐私政策保护的客户文档。

sents.en: But you’re not really sending text off-premises at any time; you only ever send embedding vectors, which look to you like random numbers.
sents.zh: 但实际上你从未在任何时候把文本发送到公司之外；你发送的只是嵌入向量，而在你看来它们就像随机数字。

sents.en: What if someone hacks into the database and gains access to all your text embedding vectors – would this be bad?
sents.zh: 如果有人入侵数据库并获取了你所有的文本嵌入向量——这会很糟糕吗？

sents.en: Or if the service provider wanted to sell your data to advertisers – could they?
sents.zh: 或者如果服务提供商想把你的数据卖给广告商——他们能做到吗？

sents.en: Both scenarios involve being able to take embedding vectors and invert them somehow back to text.
sents.zh: 这两种场景都涉及能够以某种方式将嵌入向量逆向还原回文本。

paragraphs.en: The problem of recovering text from embeddings is exactly the scenario we tackle in our paper Text Embeddings Reveal As Much as Text (EMNLP 2023). Are embedding vectors a secure format for information storage and communication? Put simply: can input text be recovered from output embeddings?
paragraphs.zh: 从嵌入向量中恢复文本的问题正是我们的论文 Text Embeddings Reveal As Much as Text（EMNLP 2023）所研究的场景。 嵌入向量是一种安全的信息存储与通信格式吗？ 简而言之：能否从输出的嵌入向量中恢复出输入文本？

sents.en: The problem of recovering text from embeddings is exactly the scenario we tackle in our paper Text Embeddings Reveal As Much as Text (EMNLP 2023).
sents.zh: 从嵌入向量中恢复文本的问题正是我们的论文 Text Embeddings Reveal As Much as Text（EMNLP 2023）所研究的场景。

sents.en: Are embedding vectors a secure format for information storage and communication?
sents.zh: 嵌入向量是一种安全的信息存储与通信格式吗？

sents.en: Put simply: can input text be recovered from output embeddings?
sents.zh: 简而言之：能否从输出的嵌入向量中恢复出输入文本？

paragraphs.en: Before diving into solutions, let’s think about the problem a little bit more. Text embeddings are the output of neural networks, sequences of matrix multiplications joined by nonlinear function operations applied to input data. In traditional text processing neural networks, a string input is split into a number of token vectors, which repeatedly undergo nonlinear function operations. At the output layer of the model, tokens are averaged into a single embedding vector.
paragraphs.zh: 在深入探讨解决方案之前，让我们再多思考一下这个问题。 文本嵌入是神经网络的输出，是由应用于输入数据的非线性函数运算串联起来的一系列矩阵乘法。 在传统的文本处理神经网络中，字符串输入会被拆分为若干词元向量，这些词元向量会反复经历非线性函数运算。 在模型的输出层，各词元被平均为单个嵌入向量。

sents.en: Before diving into solutions, let’s think about the problem a little bit more.
sents.zh: 在深入探讨解决方案之前，让我们再多思考一下这个问题。

sents.en: Text embeddings are the output of neural networks, sequences of matrix multiplications joined by nonlinear function operations applied to input data.
sents.zh: 文本嵌入是神经网络的输出，是由应用于输入数据的非线性函数运算串联起来的一系列矩阵乘法。

sents.en: In traditional text processing neural networks, a string input is split into a number of token vectors, which repeatedly undergo nonlinear function operations.
sents.zh: 在传统的文本处理神经网络中，字符串输入会被拆分为若干词元向量，这些词元向量会反复经历非线性函数运算。

sents.en: At the output layer of the model, tokens are averaged into a single embedding vector.
sents.zh: 在模型的输出层，各词元被平均为单个嵌入向量。

paragraphs.en: A maxim from the signal processing community known as the data processing inequality tells us that functions cannot add information to an input, they can only sustain or decrease the amount of information available. Even though conventional wisdom tells us that deeper layers of a neural network are constructing ever-higher-order representations, they aren’t adding any information about the world that didn’t come in on the input side.
paragraphs.zh: 信号处理界有一句格言，称为数据处理不等式，它告诉我们：函数不能为输入增加信息，只能维持或减少已有信息的数量。 尽管传统观点告诉我们，神经网络的更深层在构建越来越高阶的表示，但它们并未添加任何关于世界的、并非来自输入端的信息。

sents.en: A maxim from the signal processing community known as the data processing inequality tells us that functions cannot add information to an input, they can only sustain or decrease the amount of information available.
sents.zh: 信号处理界有一句格言，称为数据处理不等式，它告诉我们：函数不能为输入增加信息，只能维持或减少已有信息的数量。

sents.en: Even though conventional wisdom tells us that deeper layers of a neural network are constructing ever-higher-order representations, they aren’t adding any information about the world that didn’t come in on the input side.
sents.zh: 尽管传统观点告诉我们，神经网络的更深层在构建越来越高阶的表示，但它们并未添加任何关于世界的、并非来自输入端的信息。

paragraphs.en: Additionally, the nonlinear layers certainly destroy some information. One ubiquitous nonlinear layer in modern neural networks is the “ReLU” function, which simply sets all negative inputs to zero. After applying ReLU throughout the many layers of a typical text embedding model, it is not possible to retain all the information from the input.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，非线性层必然会破坏一些信息。 现代神经网络中一种无处不在的非线性层是「ReLU」函数，它只是将所有负输入设为零。 在典型的文本嵌入模型的众多层中应用 ReLU 之后，就不可能保留输入的全部信息了。

sents.en: Additionally, the nonlinear layers certainly destroy some information.
sents.zh: 此外，非线性层必然会破坏一些信息。

sents.en: One ubiquitous nonlinear layer in modern neural networks is the “ReLU” function, which simply sets all negative inputs to zero.
sents.zh: 现代神经网络中一种无处不在的非线性层是「ReLU」函数，它只是将所有负输入设为零。

sents.en: After applying ReLU throughout the many layers of a typical text embedding model, it is not possible to retain all the information from the input.
sents.zh: 在典型的文本嵌入模型的众多层中应用 ReLU 之后，就不可能保留输入的全部信息了。

paragraphs.en: Similar questions about information content have been asked in the computer vision community. Several results have shown that deep representations (embeddings, essentially) from image models can be used to recover the input images with some degree of fidelity. An early result (Dosovitskiy, 2016) showed that images can be recovered from the feature outputs of deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs). Given the high-level feature representation from a CNN, they could invert it to produce a blurry-but-similar version of the original input image.
paragraphs.zh: 计算机视觉领域也曾提出过关于信息内容的类似问题。 多项结果表明，图像模型的深层表示（本质上是嵌入）可以用来以一定的保真度恢复输入图像。 一项早期研究（Dosovitskiy, 2016）表明，图像可以从深度卷积神经网络（CNN）的特征输出中被恢复出来。 给定来自 CNN 的高层特征表示，他们可以将其逆变换，生成与原始输入图像模糊但相似的版本。

sents.en: Similar questions about information content have been asked in the computer vision community.
sents.zh: 计算机视觉领域也曾提出过关于信息内容的类似问题。

sents.en: Several results have shown that deep representations (embeddings, essentially) from image models can be used to recover the input images with some degree of fidelity.
sents.zh: 多项结果表明，图像模型的深层表示（本质上是嵌入）可以用来以一定的保真度恢复输入图像。

sents.en: An early result (Dosovitskiy, 2016) showed that images can be recovered from the feature outputs of deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs).
sents.zh: 一项早期研究（Dosovitskiy, 2016）表明，图像可以从深度卷积神经网络（CNN）的特征输出中被恢复出来。

sents.en: Given the high-level feature representation from a CNN, they could invert it to produce a blurry-but-similar version of the original input image.
sents.zh: 给定来自 CNN 的高层特征表示，他们可以将其逆变换，生成与原始输入图像模糊但相似的版本。

paragraphs.en: People have improved on image embedding inversion process since 2016: models have been developed that do inversion with higher accuracy , and have been shown to work across more settings . Surprisingly, some work has shown that images can be inverted from the outputs of an ImageNet classifier (1000 class probabilities).
paragraphs.zh: 自2016年以来，人们不断改进图像嵌入的逆向还原过程：已经开发出能够以更高准确度进行逆向还原的模型，并已被证明在更多场景下有效。 令人惊讶的是，一些研究表明，图像可以从ImageNet分类器的输出（1000个类别的概率）中被逆向还原出来。

sents.en: People have improved on image embedding inversion process since 2016: models have been developed that do inversion with higher accuracy , and have been shown to work across more settings .
sents.zh: 自2016年以来，人们不断改进图像嵌入的逆向还原过程：已经开发出能够以更高准确度进行逆向还原的模型，并已被证明在更多场景下有效。

sents.en: Surprisingly, some work has shown that images can be inverted from the outputs of an ImageNet classifier (1000 class probabilities).
sents.zh: 令人惊讶的是，一些研究表明，图像可以从ImageNet分类器的输出（1000个类别的概率）中被逆向还原出来。

paragraphs.en: If inversion is possible for image representations, then why can’t it work for text? Let’s consider a toy problem of recovering text embeddings. For our toy setting we’ll restrict text inputs to 32 tokens (around 25 words, a sentence of decent length) and embed them all to vectors of 768 floating-point numbers. At 32-bit precision, these embeddings are 32 * 768 = 24,576 bits or around 3 kilobytes.
paragraphs.zh: 如果图像表示可以进行反演，那为什么文本不能呢？ 让我们考虑一个恢复文本嵌入的简单问题。 在这个简单设定中，我们将文本输入限制为 32 个词元（约 25 个单词，长度适中的一句话），并将它们全部嵌入为 768 个浮点数组成的向量。 在 32 位精度下，这些嵌入的大小为 32 * 768 = 24,576 位，约 3 千字节。

sents.en: If inversion is possible for image representations, then why can’t it work for text?
sents.zh: 如果图像表示可以进行反演，那为什么文本不能呢？

sents.en: Let’s consider a toy problem of recovering text embeddings.
sents.zh: 让我们考虑一个恢复文本嵌入的简单问题。

sents.en: For our toy setting we’ll restrict text inputs to 32 tokens (around 25 words, a sentence of decent length) and embed them all to vectors of 768 floating-point numbers.
sents.zh: 在这个简单设定中，我们将文本输入限制为 32 个词元（约 25 个单词，长度适中的一句话），并将它们全部嵌入为 768 个浮点数组成的向量。

sents.en: At 32-bit precision, these embeddings are 32 * 768 = 24,576 bits or around 3 kilobytes.
sents.zh: 在 32 位精度下，这些嵌入的大小为 32 * 768 = 24,576 位，约 3 千字节。

paragraphs.en: Few words represented by many bits. Do you think we could perfectly reconstruct the text within this scenario?
paragraphs.zh: 少量文字由许多比特表示。 你认为在这个场景中我们能完美地重建文本吗？

sents.en: Few words represented by many bits.
sents.zh: 少量文字由许多比特表示。

sents.en: Do you think we could perfectly reconstruct the text within this scenario?
sents.zh: 你认为在这个场景中我们能完美地重建文本吗？

paragraphs.en: First things first: we need to define a measurement of goodness , to know how well we have accomplished our task. One obvious metric is "exact match", how often we get the exact input back after inversion. No prior inversion methods have any success on exact match, so it’s quite an ambitious measurement. So maybe we want to start with a smooth measurement that measures how similar the inverted text is to the input. For this we’ll use BLEU score, which you can just think of as a percentage of how close the inverted text is to the input.
paragraphs.zh: 首先要做的事：我们需要定义一种「好坏」的度量标准，以了解我们把任务完成得有多好。 一个显而易见的指标是「完全匹配」，即反转后有多少次能原样得到输入。 以往的反转方法在完全匹配上都毫无成功，所以这是一个相当有野心的度量标准。 因此，也许我们应该从一个平滑的度量开始，用它来衡量反转文本与输入的相似程度。 为此我们将使用 BLEU 分数，你可以直接把它理解为反转文本与输入接近程度的百分比。

sents.en: First things first: we need to define a measurement of goodness , to know how well we have accomplished our task.
sents.zh: 首先要做的事：我们需要定义一种「好坏」的度量标准，以了解我们把任务完成得有多好。

sents.en: One obvious metric is "exact match", how often we get the exact input back after inversion.
sents.zh: 一个显而易见的指标是「完全匹配」，即反转后有多少次能原样得到输入。

sents.en: No prior inversion methods have any success on exact match, so it’s quite an ambitious measurement.
sents.zh: 以往的反转方法在完全匹配上都毫无成功，所以这是一个相当有野心的度量标准。

sents.en: So maybe we want to start with a smooth measurement that measures how similar the inverted text is to the input.
sents.zh: 因此，也许我们应该从一个平滑的度量开始，用它来衡量反转文本与输入的相似程度。

sents.en: For this we’ll use BLEU score, which you can just think of as a percentage of how close the inverted text is to the input.
sents.zh: 为此我们将使用 BLEU 分数，你可以直接把它理解为反转文本与输入接近程度的百分比。

paragraphs.en: With our success metric defined, let us move on to proposing an approach to evaluate with said metric. For a first approach, we can pose inversion as a traditional machine learning problem, and we solve it the best way we know how: by gathering a large dataset of embedding-text pairs, and train a model to output the text given the embedding as input.
paragraphs.zh: 定义好成功指标后，接下来我们提出一种用该指标进行评估的方法。 作为第一种方法，我们可以把反演当作一个传统的机器学习问题，并用我们所知最好的方式来解决它：收集一个大规模的嵌入-文本对数据集，然后训练一个模型，以嵌入作为输入来输出对应的文本。

sents.en: With our success metric defined, let us move on to proposing an approach to evaluate with said metric.
sents.zh: 定义好成功指标后，接下来我们提出一种用该指标进行评估的方法。

sents.en: For a first approach, we can pose inversion as a traditional machine learning problem, and we solve it the best way we know how: by gathering a large dataset of embedding-text pairs, and train a model to output the text given the embedding as input.
sents.zh: 作为第一种方法，我们可以把反演当作一个传统的机器学习问题，并用我们所知最好的方式来解决它：收集一个大规模的嵌入-文本对数据集，然后训练一个模型，以嵌入作为输入来输出对应的文本。

paragraphs.en: So this is what we did. We build a transformer that takes the embedding as input and train it using traditional language modeling on the output text. This first approach gives us a model with a BLEU score of around 30/100. Practically, the model can guess the topic of the input text, and get some of the words, but it loses their order and often gets most of them wrong. The exact match score is close to zero. It turns out that asking a model to reverse the output of another model in a single forward pass is quite hard (as are other complicated text generation tasks, like generating text in perfect sonnet form or satisfying multiple attributes).
paragraphs.zh: 这就是我们之前所做的工作。 我们构建了一个以嵌入作为输入的 Transformer，并在输出文本上使用传统语言建模方法进行训练。 这第一种方法得到的模型 BLEU 分数约为 30/100。 实际上，该模型能够猜出输入文本的主题，并识别出其中的一些词，但会丢失词的顺序，而且大多数词经常猜错。 其精确匹配分数接近于零。 事实证明，要求模型在单次前向传播中反转另一个模型的输出是相当困难的（其他复杂的文本生成任务也一样，比如以完美的十四行诗格式生成文本，或同时满足多个属性）。

sents.en: So this is what we did.
sents.zh: 这就是我们之前所做的工作。

sents.en: We build a transformer that takes the embedding as input and train it using traditional language modeling on the output text.
sents.zh: 我们构建了一个以嵌入作为输入的 Transformer，并在输出文本上使用传统语言建模方法进行训练。

sents.en: This first approach gives us a model with a BLEU score of around 30/100.
sents.zh: 这第一种方法得到的模型 BLEU 分数约为 30/100。

sents.en: Practically, the model can guess the topic of the input text, and get some of the words, but it loses their order and often gets most of them wrong.
sents.zh: 实际上，该模型能够猜出输入文本的主题，并识别出其中的一些词，但会丢失词的顺序，而且大多数词经常猜错。

sents.en: The exact match score is close to zero.
sents.zh: 其精确匹配分数接近于零。

sents.en: It turns out that asking a model to reverse the output of another model in a single forward pass is quite hard (as are other complicated text generation tasks, like generating text in perfect sonnet form or satisfying multiple attributes).
sents.zh: 事实证明，要求模型在单次前向传播中反转另一个模型的输出是相当困难的（其他复杂的文本生成任务也一样，比如以完美的十四行诗格式生成文本，或同时满足多个属性）。

paragraphs.en: After training our initial model, we noticed something interesting. A different way to measure model output quality is by re-embedding the generated text (we call this the “hypothesis”) and measuring this embedding’s similarity to the true embedding. When we do this with our model’s generations, we see a very high cosine similarity – around 0.97. This means that we’re able to generate text that’s close in embedding space, but not identical to, the ground-truth text.
paragraphs.zh: 在训练我们的初始模型后，我们注意到一个有趣的现象。 衡量模型输出质量的另一种方法是对生成的文本（我们称之为“假设”）重新进行嵌入，并测量该嵌入与真实嵌入之间的相似度。 当我们对模型生成的文本这样做时，我们会看到非常高的余弦相似度——大约为 0.97。 这意味着我们能够生成在嵌入空间中接近但不完全等同于真实文本的内容。

sents.en: After training our initial model, we noticed something interesting.
sents.zh: 在训练我们的初始模型后，我们注意到一个有趣的现象。

sents.en: A different way to measure model output quality is by re-embedding the generated text (we call this the “hypothesis”) and measuring this embedding’s similarity to the true embedding.
sents.zh: 衡量模型输出质量的另一种方法是对生成的文本（我们称之为“假设”）重新进行嵌入，并测量该嵌入与真实嵌入之间的相似度。

sents.en: When we do this with our model’s generations, we see a very high cosine similarity – around 0.97.
sents.zh: 当我们对模型生成的文本这样做时，我们会看到非常高的余弦相似度——大约为 0.97。

sents.en: This means that we’re able to generate text that’s close in embedding space, but not identical to, the ground-truth text.
sents.zh: 这意味着我们能够生成在嵌入空间中接近但不完全等同于真实文本的内容。

paragraphs.en: (An aside: what if this weren’t the case? That is, what if the embedding assigned our incorrect hypothesis the same embedding as the original sequence. Our embedder would be lossy , mapping multiple inputs to the same output. If this were the case, then our problem would be hopeless, and we would have no way of distinguishing which of multiple possible sequences produced it. In practice, we never observe these types of collisions in our experiments.)
paragraphs.zh: （题外话：如果情况不是这样会怎样？ 也就是说，如果嵌入把我们的错误假设映射为与原始序列相同的嵌入会怎样。 我们的嵌入器将是有损的，会把多个输入映射到同一个输出。 如果真是这样，那么我们的问题将无解，我们将无法区分多个可能的序列中究竟是哪一个产生了它。 在实践中，我们在实验中从未观察到这类冲突。）

sents.en: (An aside: what if this weren’t the case?
sents.zh: （题外话：如果情况不是这样会怎样？

sents.en: That is, what if the embedding assigned our incorrect hypothesis the same embedding as the original sequence.
sents.zh: 也就是说，如果嵌入把我们的错误假设映射为与原始序列相同的嵌入会怎样。

sents.en: Our embedder would be lossy , mapping multiple inputs to the same output.
sents.zh: 我们的嵌入器将是有损的，会把多个输入映射到同一个输出。

sents.en: If this were the case, then our problem would be hopeless, and we would have no way of distinguishing which of multiple possible sequences produced it.
sents.zh: 如果真是这样，那么我们的问题将无解，我们将无法区分多个可能的序列中究竟是哪一个产生了它。

sents.en: In practice, we never observe these types of collisions in our experiments.)
sents.zh: 在实践中，我们在实验中从未观察到这类冲突。）

paragraphs.en: The observation that hypotheses have different embeddings to the ground truth inspires an optimization-like approach to embedding inversion. Given a ground-truth embedding (where we want to go), and a current hypothesis text and its embedding (where we are right now), we can train a corrector model that’s trained to output something that’s closer to the ground-truth than the hypothesis.
paragraphs.zh: 假设（hypotheses）与真实嵌入具有不同的嵌入这一观察结果，启发了一种类似优化的方法来进行嵌入反演。 给定一个真实嵌入（我们想去的地方），以及当前的假设文本及其嵌入（我们现在所在的地方），我们可以训练一个校正模型，该模型经训练后能输出比假设更接近真实值的结果。

sents.en: The observation that hypotheses have different embeddings to the ground truth inspires an optimization-like approach to embedding inversion.
sents.zh: 假设（hypotheses）与真实嵌入具有不同的嵌入这一观察结果，启发了一种类似优化的方法来进行嵌入反演。

sents.en: Given a ground-truth embedding (where we want to go), and a current hypothesis text and its embedding (where we are right now), we can train a corrector model that’s trained to output something that’s closer to the ground-truth than the hypothesis.
sents.zh: 给定一个真实嵌入（我们想去的地方），以及当前的假设文本及其嵌入（我们现在所在的地方），我们可以训练一个校正模型，该模型经训练后能输出比假设更接近真实值的结果。

paragraphs.en: Our goal is now clear: we want to build a system that can take a ground-truth embedding, a hypothesis text sequence, and the hypothesis position in embedding space, and predict the true text sequence. We think of this as a type of ‘learned optimization’ where we’re taking steps in embedding space in the form of discrete sequences. This is the essence of our method, which we call vec2text.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的目标现在很明确：我们想构建一个系统，它能接收真实嵌入、一个假设文本序列以及该假设在嵌入空间中的位置，并预测出真实的文本序列。 我们将其视为一种“学习到的优化”，即以离散序列的形式在嵌入空间中迈出步伐。 这就是我们称之为 vec2text 的方法的精髓所在。

sents.en: Our goal is now clear: we want to build a system that can take a ground-truth embedding, a hypothesis text sequence, and the hypothesis position in embedding space, and predict the true text sequence.
sents.zh: 我们的目标现在很明确：我们想构建一个系统，它能接收真实嵌入、一个假设文本序列以及该假设在嵌入空间中的位置，并预测出真实的文本序列。

sents.en: We think of this as a type of ‘learned optimization’ where we’re taking steps in embedding space in the form of discrete sequences.
sents.zh: 我们将其视为一种“学习到的优化”，即以离散序列的形式在嵌入空间中迈出步伐。

sents.en: This is the essence of our method, which we call vec2text.
sents.zh: 这就是我们称之为 vec2text 的方法的精髓所在。

paragraphs.en: After working through some details and training the model, this process works extremely well! A single forward pass of correction increases the BLEU score from 30 to 50. And one benefit of this model is that it can naturally be queried recursively. Given a current text and its embedding, we can run many steps of this optimization, iteratively generating hypotheses, re-embedding them, and feeding them back in as input to the model. With 50 steps and a few tricks, we can get back 92% of 32-token sequences exactly, and get to a BLEU score of 97! (Generally achieving BLEU score of 97 means we’re almost perfectly reconstructing every sentence, perhaps with a few punctuation marks misplaced here and there.)
paragraphs.zh: 在梳理了一些细节并对模型进行训练之后，这一过程的效果非常好！ 单次前向传递的修正就能将 BLEU 分数从 30 提升到 50。 这个模型的一个好处是，它可以自然地进行递归查询。 给定当前文本及其嵌入，我们可以执行许多步这样的优化，迭代地生成假设、重新嵌入它们，并将它们作为输入反馈给模型。 经过 50 步和几个小技巧，我们可以完整还原 92% 的 32 词元序列，并将 BLEU 分数提升到 97！ （通常来说，BLEU 分数达到 97 意味着我们几乎完美地重构了每一个句子，只是这里或那里可能错置了几个标点符号。）

sents.en: After working through some details and training the model, this process works extremely well!
sents.zh: 在梳理了一些细节并对模型进行训练之后，这一过程的效果非常好！

sents.en: A single forward pass of correction increases the BLEU score from 30 to 50.
sents.zh: 单次前向传递的修正就能将 BLEU 分数从 30 提升到 50。

sents.en: And one benefit of this model is that it can naturally be queried recursively.
sents.zh: 这个模型的一个好处是，它可以自然地进行递归查询。

sents.en: Given a current text and its embedding, we can run many steps of this optimization, iteratively generating hypotheses, re-embedding them, and feeding them back in as input to the model.
sents.zh: 给定当前文本及其嵌入，我们可以执行许多步这样的优化，迭代地生成假设、重新嵌入它们，并将它们作为输入反馈给模型。

sents.en: With 50 steps and a few tricks, we can get back 92% of 32-token sequences exactly, and get to a BLEU score of 97!
sents.zh: 经过 50 步和几个小技巧，我们可以完整还原 92% 的 32 词元序列，并将 BLEU 分数提升到 97！

sents.en: (Generally achieving BLEU score of 97 means we’re almost perfectly reconstructing every sentence, perhaps with a few punctuation marks misplaced here and there.)
sents.zh: （通常来说，BLEU 分数达到 97 意味着我们几乎完美地重构了每一个句子，只是这里或那里可能错置了几个标点符号。）

paragraphs.en: The fact that text embeddings can be perfectly inverted raises many follow-up questions. For one, the text embedding vector contains a fixed number of bits; there must be some sequence length at which information can no longer be perfectly stored within this vector. Even though we can recover most texts of length 32, some embedding models can embed documents up to thousands of tokens. We leave it up to future work to analyze the relationship between text length, embedding size, and embedding invertibility.
paragraphs.zh: 文本嵌入可以被完美地逆向还原这一事实引发了许多后续问题。 首先，文本嵌入向量包含的比特数是固定的；必然存在某个序列长度，超过该长度后信息就无法再被完美地存储在这个向量中。 尽管我们能够恢复大多数长度为 32 的文本，但一些嵌入模型可以嵌入多达数千个 token 的文档。 我们把分析文本长度、嵌入大小与嵌入可逆性之间关系的工作留给未来研究。

sents.en: The fact that text embeddings can be perfectly inverted raises many follow-up questions.
sents.zh: 文本嵌入可以被完美地逆向还原这一事实引发了许多后续问题。

sents.en: For one, the text embedding vector contains a fixed number of bits; there must be some sequence length at which information can no longer be perfectly stored within this vector.
sents.zh: 首先，文本嵌入向量包含的比特数是固定的；必然存在某个序列长度，超过该长度后信息就无法再被完美地存储在这个向量中。

sents.en: Even though we can recover most texts of length 32, some embedding models can embed documents up to thousands of tokens.
sents.zh: 尽管我们能够恢复大多数长度为 32 的文本，但一些嵌入模型可以嵌入多达数千个 token 的文档。

sents.en: We leave it up to future work to analyze the relationship between text length, embedding size, and embedding invertibility.
sents.zh: 我们把分析文本长度、嵌入大小与嵌入可逆性之间关系的工作留给未来研究。

paragraphs.en: Another open question is how to build systems that can defend against inversion. Is it possible to create models that can successfully embed text such that embeddings remain useful while obfuscating the text that created them?
paragraphs.zh: 另一个悬而未决的问题是如何构建能够防御反演的系统。 是否有可能创建出能够成功对文本进行嵌入的模型，使得嵌入保持有用，同时对生成这些嵌入的文本进行混淆？

sents.en: Another open question is how to build systems that can defend against inversion.
sents.zh: 另一个悬而未决的问题是如何构建能够防御反演的系统。

sents.en: Is it possible to create models that can successfully embed text such that embeddings remain useful while obfuscating the text that created them?
sents.zh: 是否有可能创建出能够成功对文本进行嵌入的模型，使得嵌入保持有用，同时对生成这些嵌入的文本进行混淆？

paragraphs.en: Finally, we are excited to see how our method might apply to other modalities. The main idea behind vec2text (a sort of iterative optimization in embedding space) doesn’t use any text-specific tricks. It’s a method that iteratively recovers information contained in any fixed input, given black-box access to a model. It remains to be seen how these ideas might apply to inverting embeddings from other modalities as well as to approaches more general than embedding inversion.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，我们很高兴看到我们的方法可能如何应用于其他模态。 vec2text 背后的主要思想（一种在嵌入空间中的迭代优化）没有使用任何针对文本的特定技巧。 这是一种在对模型具有黑盒访问权限的条件下，迭代恢复任何固定输入中所含信息的方法。 这些思想如何应用于反转其他模态的嵌入，以及应用于比嵌入反转更宽泛的方法，仍有待观察。

sents.en: Finally, we are excited to see how our method might apply to other modalities.
sents.zh: 最后，我们很高兴看到我们的方法可能如何应用于其他模态。

sents.en: The main idea behind vec2text (a sort of iterative optimization in embedding space) doesn’t use any text-specific tricks.
sents.zh: vec2text 背后的主要思想（一种在嵌入空间中的迭代优化）没有使用任何针对文本的特定技巧。

sents.en: It’s a method that iteratively recovers information contained in any fixed input, given black-box access to a model.
sents.zh: 这是一种在对模型具有黑盒访问权限的条件下，迭代恢复任何固定输入中所含信息的方法。

sents.en: It remains to be seen how these ideas might apply to inverting embeddings from other modalities as well as to approaches more general than embedding inversion.
sents.zh: 这些思想如何应用于反转其他模态的嵌入，以及应用于比嵌入反转更宽泛的方法，仍有待观察。
